meta_description: Hughes Plastering in Sheffield. Expert plastering, renders, and finishing work. Local, reliable, and fully insured. Call 07815 050409 for a free quote today.
hero_subhead: From feature walls to full renders, we transform your spaces with precision finishing. Same-week appointments available.
services_subhead: Whether you need interior finishing, external renders, or decorative plasterwork, we handle every project with care and precision.

services.title: Interior Plastering & Skimming
services.desc: Expert finishing of walls and ceilings — from damp repairs to smooth skimming coats. We leave surfaces ready for immediate decoration, saving you time and money.

services.title: Render & External Plasterwork
services.desc: Durable external renders that protect your property and improve kerb appeal. We use quality materials and proven techniques for long-lasting finishes.

services.title: Artex Removal & Remedial Work
services.desc: Safe removal of old Artex and textured finishes, followed by professional skimming to restore clean, modern walls.

services.title: Coving & Cornice Installation
services.desc: Precision installation of coving, cornicing, and decorative plasterwork to add character and finish to your rooms.

services.title: Damp & Structural Repairs
services.desc: Specialised plasterwork on damp-damaged walls and structural cracks. We prepare surfaces properly for lasting results.

services.title: Feature Walls & Bespoke Finishes
services.desc: Textured feature walls, exposed brick preparation, and bespoke finishes that bring personality to your space.

about_pullquote: We turn rough walls into finished spaces that homeowners are proud of.
about_para_1: Hughes Plastering has been serving Sheffield homes and businesses for over a decade. We started because we saw too many rushed, sloppy finishes — corners cut, dust left behind, poor quality materials. We decided to do it differently: properly trained, fully insured, and always transparent about what the job needs.
about_para_2: Our customers choose us because we show up on time, we communicate clearly about timescales and cost, and we leave sites clean. We take pride in detail — the difference between a wall that looks flat and one that's genuinely finished to trade standard. Many of our jobs come from repeat customers and word-of-mouth referrals.
reviews_heading: What Sheffield Customers Say About Hughes Plastering

reviews.text: Had Mark and the team in to skim three rooms. Brilliant job — took two days, left the place spotless, and the walls are perfectly smooth. Quoted fair and didn't try to upsell us. Will be using them again when we decorate the hallway.
reviews.author: David K.

reviews.text: Came out to look at water damage from a leak upstairs. Explained exactly what needed doing, got the work done in one day, and the finish is flawless. Much better than the last plasterer we used. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Catherine M.

reviews.text: Called on a Monday, they were here Wednesday morning. Feature wall looks amazing — way better than I imagined. Professional lads, no mess, fair price. Top work.
reviews.author: Paul T.
